topics.quote: robin made a motion to accept the minutes of december 22, 2025, as presented, seconded by stephanie. the motion passed with five votes, with jana abstaining.

on friday, january 16, minna scholten will start as our new library assistant in the children's room. sherri and lydia are working on a system to track and manage loans through the meals on wheels book delivery program.

january started slowly for program attendance, possibly due to the cold weather and level of winter illness in the area. later in the month the new yoga program and the winter sowing program were both well-attended.
lydia communicated with chris ruth about snow removal. on a snowy saturday, the snow removal crew arrived in the afternoon, well past opening time.
we began our review of the massachusetts public library trustee handbook. we covered chapter one - becoming a trustee and chapter two - board organization.
